name: ContentByUri
query: fragment ContentFields on ContentNode { __typename databaseId status uri ... on NodeWithContentEditor { content } ... on NodeWithTitle { title } ... on Post { author { node { name } } date } ... on WithAcfHero { hero { cta { target title url } eyebrow headline intro } } } query ContentByUri($uri: String!) { nodeByUri(uri: $uri) { ... on ContentNode { ...ContentFields } } }

name: Layout
query: query Layout { generalSettings { description title } menuItems(where: { location: PRIMARY }, first: 20) { nodes { id label target uri } } }

name: PreviewContent
query: fragment ContentFields on ContentNode { __typename databaseId status uri ... on NodeWithContentEditor { content } ... on NodeWithTitle { title } ... on Post { author { node { name } } date } ... on WithAcfHero { hero { cta { target title url } eyebrow headline intro } } } query PreviewContent($id: ID!) { contentNode(id: $id, idType: DATABASE_ID) { ...ContentFields } }
